name: AirAsia Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司由 AirAsia X Berhad 更名为 AirAsia Group Berhad，并持续推进涉及 AAAGL 与 AAB 的收购提案及配套的免费凭单、私下配售、股本削减等企业行动。公司未在公告中披露新增或缩减业务板块的具体营运变化。
overview_en: In 2026, the company changed its name from AirAsia X Berhad to AirAsia Group Berhad and continued to pursue the proposed AAAGL and AAB acquisitions alongside related corporate exercises including free warrants, a private placement and a share capital reduction. No specific operational changes involving new or reduced business segments were disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司今年完成名称变更，并继续推进 AAAGL 与 AAB 收购等企业提案。
segments.note_en: The company completed its name change this year and continued to pursue corporate proposals including the AAAGL and AAB acquisitions.

actions.title: Change of Company Name - AIRASIA GROUP BERHAD
actions.text: 公司名称由 AirAsia X Berhad 变更为 AirAsia Group Berhad。
actions.text_en: The company name was changed from AirAsia X Berhad to AirAsia Group Berhad.

actions.text: 公告涉及免费凭单发行、私下配售、AAAGL 收购、AAB 收购及股本削减等提案。
